主要内容: On February 23, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp. issued a press release announcing that it received an investment grade rating of A- from Egan-Jones Ratings Co. The rating reflects the Company's financial strength and creditworthiness. This event is being reported under Item 8.01 of Form 8-K. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference. The information in the press release is not being filed for the purpose of registration under the Securities Act of 1933, unless specifically identified as such. The Company's Chief Financial Officer, Larry D. Hall, signed the report on February 29, 2016. The event is relevant to the Company's financial standing and may influence investor perceptions and market sentiment within the financial services industry.
